description: Cross-language interop vectors for CsrfTokenManager. Each token was generated by that language's CsrfTokenManager, constructed with the same secret, for the same session ID, with ttl<=0 (never-expiring) so the fixture stays verifiable indefinitely. Every language's verify(sessionId, token), constructed with the same secret and ttl<=0, must return true for every entry, proving the HMAC-SHA256 binary token format (8-byte big-endian timestamp || 16-byte nonce || 32-byte HMAC tag, base64url-encoded without padding) is portable across all five ports.
